method: The baseline was exported with git archive into an independent temporary directory. Separate Python processes imported all source/index dependencies from each repository root and ran identical neutral fixtures through both actual builders. The working branch was never reset.

fact_store.query_count_scope: Program/source/field fact lookups; constructor metadata and schema reads are excluded.

targeted_scale.measurement_scope: One local run per builder, with no model request. Timings report mechanism cost and are not a general throughput or model accuracy improvement claim.
